title: Optimize vector search scored candidate preallocation
constraints: Preserve HNSW search, exact distance reranking, limiting, and ordering semantics
rationale: Vector search already knows the number of HNSW candidate ids returned before exact-distance reranking. Preallocating the scored candidate vector from that count avoids Vec growth while retaining the same filtering and reranking behavior.
steps: Replace iterator collect with explicit scored vector construction
Preallocate scored candidates from HNSW result count
Keep exact Euclidean distance reranking and limit trimming unchanged
Verify vector index unit behavior and SQL HNSW ordering behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn during vector search candidate reranking without changing result order or distances.
